notes.title: Version 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Updated Ren'Py engine to version 8.2.0
 Implemented Ren'Py "Deferred Translation Loading", which should reduce loading times and slightly improve in-game performance.

notes.title: Version 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Removed some now-unneeded translations.
 Fixed the yes/no UI for a new prompt added in ren'Py 8.1.0

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Updated Ren'Py engine to 8.1.0.
 Updated "More games" section in Extras menu.

notes.title: Version 1.0.9
notes.notes: Updated Ren'Py engine from 7.4.2 to 8.0.0 and streamlined code to hopefully make the game run faster and more efficiently.

notes.title: 3/6/2021 Update
notes.notes: Added Hungarian translation (Thanks to Ágost "The Dreadist" Veres)

notes.title: 2/21/2021 Update
notes.notes:
Updated Ren'Py to latest version (7.4.2)
Added Simplified Chinese translation (Thanks to Windyshine!) and reorganized language selection onto the main menu.
Bugfixes involving the audio preview buttons in the settings menu
